plan.slice: local durable writer lifetime ownership and reopen boundary

source.dirty_note: Unrelated sibling WIP files were present before this lane and were not staged, changed, or discarded.

change.summary: Add a stable, hashed per-database/per-lease sidecar lock retained for the lifetime of ProductionDurableWriter; reject a second same-lease opener with WriterBusy, recheck the exact lease head after lock acquisition, and permit replay after the first owner drops.
invariants: Two local writer handles cannot concurrently own the same active lease under the same grant.
The failed second open appends no lease, event, outbox, or recovery row.
The lock path is derived from canonical database path and lease id and is never removed, avoiding inode replacement races.
Dropping the first owner releases the OS advisory lock; a later exact reopen remains append-only and replayable.
This lock adds no grant, signer, provider, effect, shared-KG, or production authority.

qualification_index.note: Dropbox File Provider exposed a 71724-byte dataless placeholder; no index content was used as authority. Current P0 rebind remains the authoritative source package.

verification.result: baseline failure: 50 pre-existing diagnostics across hepta-memory; no new production_writer-specific lint (the reported redundant closure predates this commit)

known_gaps: The sidecar lock is host-local OS advisory coordination, not an external supervisor or trust-root authority and has no cross-host lease semantics.
No root-owned production writer seal, external signer/trust-root, KMS/HSM, or key lifecycle evidence exists.
No provider-owned signed ACK/status, physical exactly-once, or real crash-after-send authority exists.
No physical power-loss/media durability run or 1000-operation fault-injection RPO proof has been executed by this lane.
The full package clippy baseline and repository-wide formatting drift remain pre-existing and are not rewritten here.
